=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- CLAUDE.md:2251-2257 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: §28.C retains instructions to send a `PushNotification` and wait for a human `/reclarify` response alongside the new instruction that failure escalations no longer wait for a human.
  WHY: A session may follow the stale notification and human-wait path instead of handing the escalation to the judge, contradicting §28.G and the escalation command.
- .claude/commands/escalation-judge.md:36-45 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The judge is not instructed to include the PR number in `--why` for `intervention-cap` decisions.
  WHY: The cap-counting rule requires `why=` to name the same PR, so a budget grant without that reference is not counted and the exhausted choice cannot be reused.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/escalation-judge.md:36-45 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The judge is not instructed to include the PR number in `--why` for `intervention-cap` decisions.
  WHY: The cap-counting rule requires `why=` to name the same PR, so a budget grant without that reference is not counted and the exhausted choice cannot be reused.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:321 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: Cap increases are counted by stop ID rather than failure fingerprint.
  WHY: A budget or descope entry for one failure can raise the cap for a different failure with the same stop ID, without that failure receiving its own judge evaluation.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Line 321; docs/plans/retire-master-session-plan.md line 133 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Cap increases are counted by stop ID rather than failure fingerprint.
  WHY: A grant for one failure can raise the cap for a different failure with the same stop ID, allowing an extra round without that failure receiving its own judge decision.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:66, 321 | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: A `budget` grant for `fix-check-defective` reruns the same read-only check without a mechanism to correct the defect.
  WHY: The check sees the same diff and findings, so the same stop recurs after the budget choice is consumed.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:Line 66 (fix check procedure) and line 321 (budget grant procedure) | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: A `budget` grant for `fix-check-defective` reruns the same read-only check without a mechanism to correct the defect.
  WHY: The check sees the same diff and findings, so the same stop recurs after the budget choice is consumed.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/escalation-judge.md:step 7 (line 47-49) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Step 7 removes `ai:claude-blocked` only from the source issue in issue mode and does not handle the final PR in project mode.
  WHY: The project-mode label can persist after the judge makes a choice; severity disagreement: minimax reports this as `NIT`, while qwen reports it as `MAJOR`.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/escalation-judge.md:step 1 (line 23) | severity=low | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Step 1 does not specify a failure path when reading blocker-thread comments fails.
  WHY: The judge could proceed without importing previously recorded markers and offer a choice that has already been used.
- CLAUDE.md:§28.G "The fingerprint rule" bullet (around line 2400) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The wording that the judge never picks a choice already recorded can be read to include `close`, despite the stated exception that `close` is always available.
  WHY: The wording may lead a judge to rule out a repeated `close`, contrary to the ledger and the command menu.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md:"Escalation: ES-<n> <budget | descope> (stop <stop id>) — <the narrower fix | the de-scoped part>" (line 134 in the Stage Sessions template, line 320 in the Escalations section) | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The escalation resume line carries the stop ID but not the PR number needed for PR-scoped fingerprints.
  WHY: The resumed stage must recover the PR number from another source, leaving the recovery path implicit and risking failure of the fingerprint step.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
